name: piupiu
description: PiuPiu — a child-friendly English pronunciation game with four modes (falling word rain, a physics-driven fill-the-screen clear, a full-screen paintball word collage, and a line-by-line poetry reading mode) and a unified dark arcade visual system, playful effects, spoken hints with selectable natural and child voices, star-beam rewards, eight PixiJS ambience scenes, number words 1–100, local player profiles with editable avatars and a points leaderboard, three dark arcade skins, a randomly chosen soft-jelly monster companion from a 35-pet catalog each round, a Matter.js gravity pile, a ten-clear meteor sweep, and three falling speeds, PHaVE and PHRASE lists, themed packs, local custom text-file word packs, a private poetry library with public-domain demo poems, K-12 reading lists, BNC/COCA word families, Chinese/French/English UI, and PWA installation with an offline app shell.
